title: 2448. Minimum Cost to Make Array Equal

examples.explanation: We can make all the elements equal to 2 in the following way: - Increase the 0th element one time. The cost is 2. - Decrease the 1st element one time. The cost is 3. - Decrease the 2nd element three times. The cost is 1 + 1 + 1 = 3. The total cost is 2 + 3 + 3 = 8. It can be shown that we cannot make the array equal with a smaller cost.
All the elements are already equal, so no operations are needed.
